hero.headline: I build backends that stay awake so others can sleep.
hero.subline: Fourth-year Software Engineering student focused on backend development, API reliability and AI-powered applications. Looking for an internship where I can ship real software.

about.bio: I'm a fourth-year Software Engineering student at BAU in Istanbul. I work mostly in Python (FastAPI, Django) and Java (Spring Boot), and I care about the unglamorous parts of software: whether an API is up, whether it behaves the way it promises, and whether it can be tested. I'm also exploring how AI can be integrated into real applications in a practical, reliable way. I speak Arabic, French, English and Turkish, so I'm comfortable working across languages, cultures and stakeholders.

footer.tagline: Built with care, backed with tests.
